# KDP Publishing Workflow

## Overview

Complete workflow for publishing books on Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP).

## Prerequisites

- Amazon account
- Manuscript in editable format (Markdown, Word, Google Docs)
- Cover design (or budget for design)
- KDP account: https://kdp.amazon.com

## Phase 1: Preparation (Days 1-3)
